en: A color religious postcard-style image depicting Santiago Apóstol (Saint James the Apostle) as a mounted warrior saint. He rides a rearing white horse, sword raised in his right hand and a white flag with a cross in his left. Below the horse lie several defeated, armed figures in turbans and medieval-style clothing, suggesting a battle scene. In the top right corner, red Spanish text reads: "Santiago Apostol. - Patrón de España y de las Indias" against a pale sky and mountainous landscape.
